custodyProfile.uncertainty: The 2026-10-14 reserve composition pin and provider roster are retained; this 2026-10-15 custody review adds issuer-documented rights and independently pinned current custody/controls. At block 26197527, sole adapter 0x1d511811aca9d8817a3e50f29cadff6243a02902 holds 8 Morpho supply positions totaling 30215446628068 raw USDC; idle 27251845493 plus those claims equals totalAssets 30242698473561 against 29155601056107453877078191 raw shares. All enumerated positions have zero borrowing and posted collateral. Segregated describes operational separation between the named vault/adapter positions, corroborating KPK's published and archived statement that assets are not pooled across its vaults; it does not mean holder-by-holder custody accounts, enforceable legal ring-fencing or segregation of every downstream collateral issuer's assets. KPK says it never holds depositor assets and asserts no outside pledge or lien. Its disclaimer names KPK Digital Assets Inc. as curator, excludes contractual obligations to holders, and places any contractual remedies under Morpho terms. No bankruptcy-remoteness legal opinion exists, so bankruptcyRemoteness stays unknown; operational separation is not insolvency priority. Lending vault USDC to Morpho borrowers is the product's capital reuse, already graded in wrapper allocation; it is not a separately established custodian rehypothecation permission or prohibition. The disclosure says borrower collateral is not reused, but that does not establish downstream collateral issuer/custodian reuse and recovery rights; rehypothecation stays unknown for the custody profile. The no-lien assertion is issuer-documented, not independently legally verified. Blockscout partial-source-verification caveat remains. The published 75-100% liquidity target and questionnaire's unpinned Morpho API figures do not bound realization of the borrowed remainder; the whole-position liquidityHorizon stays unknown. Seed-capital leave-last is an issuer statement, not enforceable subordination or a funded backstop.
